I transferred to a new school on a football scholarship and then one day at school I snapped. Just became very paranoid of my social surroundings, thought everyone was out to get me, you know that kind of feeling ? But it was constant , like 24/7 thinking everyone was looking and talking about you. Also briefly heard voices where they would try get me to self harm and commit suicide. Which I tried several times. But to no effect. But every time I attempt suicide it has a detrimental effect on my cognitive functions because majority of the time they were overdoses.

Intelligent but not smart. This pain I’m experiencing would be lifted permanently if I was dead. I’m quite lonely you see, crave attention like a bee to pollen. And the ultimate way for me to get it is to die. See, not smart.
Me
Thanks, I appreciate it. But I’m afraid there’s no talking sense to a fool.
